Messages.Author: Rehlow
Messages.Body:
LSJ,

Shemti somehow acquires inferior obeah, blocks my predator bleeding me
and plays Peacemaker at [obe] level and then is tapped for blocking.
There are no further blocks and the action resolves. Does Shemti untap
in time for his special to deal 1 damage to the acting minion?

Thanks,
~Rehlow

Shemti's special ability
While he is ready and untapped, any minion successfully performing a
(D) action against you takes 1 damage (after resolving the action).

Peacemaker
Type: Reaction
Requires: Obeah/Presence
Only usable by a vampire who successfully blocks a (D) action directed
at you (play before combat).
[pre] Cancel combat. The action continues as if unblocked. For the
remainder of this action, all minions get -1 bleed and -1 strength.
[obe] As [pre] above, and untap this blocking vampire at the end of
the action.
[OBE] As [obe] above, but all minions get -2 bleed and -2 strength and
cannot use weapons.
